title: Radio: CAD-MDS01 Isolation Confirmed — TDoS-Strict Active

lines.text: Sup, this is COML. I’ve just confirmed on P25 console that CAD-MDS01 is isolated from RCECD-POS09. The GateKeeper TDoS-strict rule set is active on all 10-digit lines.
I’ve patched to PD Main and SO Main to alert field units that CAD data is untrusted and to confirm unit status by radio.
Repeat: all unit status must be verified via field radio. CAD is not to be trusted for availability or location. Proceed with caution on all calls.

fields.voiceStyle: Mid-40s male, steady and authoritative, slight urgency

instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should confirm isolation status and maintain talkgroup patches to field agencies without over-communicating.
